title: Clarinetists Lili and Edmond Hall; levee dances and not drinking
summary: He recalls the clarinetist Lili, who quit playing, and says Edmond Hall had a gift and rose quickly. The same block continues with playing dances on the porch and levee and his never being a drinker.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
